n.quote: Replication results: As in the original study, the hypothesis that participants would feel less bad not receiving the bonus under the fair procedure compared to not receiving the bonus under the unfair procedure was tested using an F-test on the Outcome (receiving vs. not receiving the bonus) x Procedure (fair vs. unfair) interaction in an ANOVA. The interaction effect turned out to be statistically significant: F(1,131) = 7.832, p = 0.006; n = 132. As a result, we can reject the null hypothesis of no interaction effect. The standardized effect size (Cohen’s d) is d = 0.244 (95% CI [0.071, 0.416]).
